title: Trademark Registration
description: Do you want to protect your intellectual property? Aanoor global can help you register your logo trademark registration online, which will protect your brand and establish your ownership of it. We offer affordable rates and make the process simple.

template.value: A trademark can be any word, phrase, symbol, design, or combination of these things that identifies and distinguishes the goods or services of one party from those of others. This gives the trademark owner exclusive rights to use the mark in connection with the goods or services it is registered for.

value.title: Not all trademarks are eligible for registration.
value: Which means trademarks that are descriptive of the goods or services they are used for are not eligible for registration.

value.title: The trademark brand must be used in commerce to be registered.
value: This means that you must be using the mark in connection with the goods or services it is registered for.

value.title: The trademark logo or brand name must be distinctive.
value: This means that it must be unique and memorable enough to distinguish your goods or services from those of others.

template.header: Benefits brand logo trademark registration online

value.title: Exclusive use of the mark
value: Once a trademark is registered, the owner has the exclusive right to use it in connection with the goods or services it is registered for. This means that no one else can use the mark without the owner's permission.

value.title: Protection from infringement
value: Trademark registration provides the owner with legal recourse against anyone who uses the mark without permission. This can help to prevent counterfeiting and other forms of trademark infringement.

value.title: Enhanced brand recognition
value: A registered trademark can help to enhance brand recognition and consumer confidence. When consumers see a registered trademark, they know that the product or service has been vetted by a government agency and is likely to be of good quality.

template.header: Documents Required for Company Trademark Registration
value: Filled Basic Information Requirement Document – TMQ shared from Aanor team
Power of Attorney document from applicant.
Board resolution for authorized signatory and letter of authorization for companies.

value.subHeading: The process of trademark registration can be complex, but it is important to register your trademark if you want to protect your brand and ensure that you have the exclusive right to use it.

steps.heading: TM Search Report and Consultation
steps.desc: We will conduct a search to see if there are any other trademarks that are similar to yours. We will also consult with you to make sure that your trademark is eligible for registration.

steps.heading: Power of Attorney Copy
steps.desc: This is a document that gives us the authority to act on your behalf in the trademark registration process.

steps.heading: User Affidavit Copy
steps.desc: This is a document that states that you are the owner of the trademark and that you have been using it for a certain period or proposed to be used.

steps.heading: Form TM-A
steps.desc: This is the government form that is used to register a trademark. We will fill out this form accurately and correctly and get it confirmed from applicant side.

steps.heading: Government Fees
steps.desc: After confirmation of TM-A from client side we will process the government charges a fee to register a trademark. We will make payment on your behalf.

steps.heading: Protect your brand today!
steps.desc: Contact Aanoor global to learn more about our trademark registration services. We can help you protect your intellectual property and ensure that your brand is secure.

template.value: Trademark is significant for any brand or business in India. If you are a business who needs to secure your logo and brand name of the company, then you should make use of the online application for a trademark to make trademark logo registration in India. It provides the security of logo and brand name in their respective trademark class. There are about 45 logo trademark registration classes when you can register your logo and brand in the field type.

Any business or person claiming to be owner can apply for logo trademark, and this includes company, society, individual, and proprietor. It is good to apply for a trademark as a single person. template.desc: There are multiple advantages of registering an IE Code for both importers and exporters, here you go!

value.title: No return Filing
value: IE code does not need any filling of return. There is no other procedure to be followed to maintain the IE Code validity once you have been issued with the IE code. There is no chance for any fillings needed to DGFT even if export or import transaction occurs.

value.title: Proprietors with IE Code
value: Even independent persons who are business proprietors can acquire this IE code in their own name. You need not to start a business entity for acquiring this IE code.

value.title: Exporters with IE Code
value: All exporters who export services or goods from India should mandatorily have an IE code. The code needs to be quoted when sending any shipments. Similarly, the bank needs exporters IE code when receiving the money from foreign countries.

value: All exporters who export services or goods from India should mandatorily have an IE code. The code needs to be quoted when sending any shipments. Similarly, the bank needs exporters IE code when receiving the money from foreign countries.
